expected.description: Expectations are evaluated after the use case runs. They aren't hard tests — the LLM is non-deterministic — just a sanity check.

runbook.description: Optional. When provided, the runbook is embedded into Qdrant just before the case runs, tagged with the use-case id. The diagnose node will see it among the top RAG hits.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Agent kill-switch, calibration, runtime knobs, audit log, and product info.

mode.title: Agent mode
mode.description: Kill-switch for the agent. `observe-only` is dry-run; `active` lets actions execute; `frozen` blocks everything including paging.

approvals.title: Pending approvals
approvals.empty: No actions waiting on operator approval.

agent.confirmActive: Active mode lets the agent execute remediations autonomously. OPA still gates every action.
agent.confirmFrozen: Frozen mode blocks ALL actions, including page_human. Use for incident response when you need full manual control.
agent.confirmObserve: Observe-only is dry-run; actions are logged but not executed.

table.title: Per-rule calibration
table.empty: No rules graded yet — run a use case to populate.

forecasting.title: Forecaster
forecasting.config: Edit these in `.env.local` (laptop) or the Helm `values.yaml` (cluster) and restart the api container.

baselines.title: Baseline learner
baselines.config: Baselines require Prometheus. Apply manifests/monitoring.yaml for in-cluster install (Phase 13c).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.config: Either webhook URL is optional; both can be set at once. Both get the same JSON payload when `page_human` fires.

forecastTick.label: Scheduler tick
forecastTick.hint: How often the forecaster walks every fitted baseline.

forecastWindow.label: Fit window
forecastWindow.hint: Samples per OLS fit. Larger = smoother, slower.

prometheusUrl.label: Prometheus URL
prometheusUrl.hint: Direct httpx URL or `k8s-proxy://` scheme. Empty disables baselines + forecasts.

scrapeInterval.label: Scrape interval
scrapeInterval.hint: How often the learner polls Prometheus.

queryProfile.label: Query profile
queryProfile.hint: `k8s` for in-cluster Prometheus (pod-shaped labels); `docker` for compose-side cAdvisor.

generic.label: Generic webhook
generic.hint: PagerDuty / Opsgenie / Discord / Teams / custom JSON sink.

alertmanager.label: Alertmanager bearer
alertmanager.hint: Inbound webhook auth for the /api/webhooks/alertmanager endpoint.

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.scopeHint: One install per Kubernetes cluster — not a SaaS.
deployment.jetsonHint: Local LLM (Qwen2.5-7b q4_K_M) runs on CUDA; CPU fallback supported.

loop.title: The agent loop
loop.observeDesc: Kubelet events + K8sGPT diagnostics + Prometheus baselines feed the triage layer.
loop.predictDesc: Linear-regression forecaster on every baseline; 5/15/60-min horizons drive the diagnose prompt.
loop.healDesc: Local Qwen-2.5-7b picks an action from the 10-tool catalog; OPA matrix gates execution.
loop.learnDesc: Per-rule calibration updates after every incident — 90 %-median confidence target.
